essence: A mantra succeeds for the practitioner who is devoted to it in the appropriate place.
Even a faulty mantra succeeds through conjunction with the three nectars.
The meaning is that the site is distinguished by beautiful girdles, wombs, and similar features.
One should take possession of as much ground as the sanctuary requires.
Vaiśyā-type ground is productive of wealth and grain, while śūdrā-type ground is censured.
